title: Fireside Chat: From Pilot Mountain to the Pentagon - Financing US Critical Minerals
gist: Member-only listing for a 14-minute Benchmark Summit 2026 London fireside chat with Guardian Metals Resources CEO Oliver Friesen on financing US critical minerals, framed as a path 'From Pilot Mountain to the Pentagon' and tagged Tungsten, USA and North America. No discussion content is disclosed.
